patterns.name: n8n Monorepo Structure
patterns.description: n8n uses pnpm workspaces with Turbo build orchestration

patterns.name: TypeScript Best Practices
rules: NEVER use 'any' type - use proper types or 'unknown'
Avoid type casting with 'as' - use type guards

patterns.name: Error Handling
rules: Use UnexpectedError, OperationalError or UserError instead

patterns.name: Frontend i18n
rules: All UI text must use i18n
Use CSS variables directly - never hardcode spacing
data-test-id must be a single value

gotchas.description: Always build before typecheck when changing api-types, interfaces, or cross-package dependencies
gotchas.solution: Run pnpm build before pnpm typecheck

gotchas.description: Build output should ALWAYS be redirected to file to avoid overwhelming output
When running tests, must be in package directory
gotchas.solution: Use pushd/popd to navigate: pushd packages/cli && pnpm test && popd

conventions.rule: Always use pnpm, never npm or yarn
Use Linear for tickets, reference in PRs and branches
Jest for backend unit tests, Vitest for frontend, Playwright for E2E

implementation_templates.name: Feature Implementation Flow
steps: 2. Implement backend logic in packages/cli module
4. Update frontend in packages/editor-ui with i18n support
6. Run pnpm typecheck to verify types
7. Run pnpm lint to check code quality
